title: Present a look (present_look) arguments
description: Put the look you recommend on the client's Look, Steps and Shades screens: a title, the steps to get it, the exact shades (with hex codes the client can copy) and, as the before-and-after, a try-on image you made with a try_on tool. Free. Call it after a try-on, then use ui_show to take the client there. Calling it again replaces the previous look.

question.description: A neutral restatement of the client's question.

image_id.description: A try-on result image id returned by a try_on tool.

before_photo_id.description: The client's photo to show as the before. Omit for none.
